verdict.rationale: Mercury's own launch post says a full accounting API is coming 'Soon', so no Books API exists today. The evidence shows no documented endpoint or export for the general ledger or trial balance, in any format. The invoicing API is a different capability, accounting-software sync is an adjacent integration, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
